roadmap.title: Main story and combat basics
roadmap.description: Play the main story on any difficulty, learning stances and collecting early upgrades. Unlock the 12 story achievements and the combat and upgrade ones that come naturally.

roadmap.title: Tales of Tsushima
roadmap.description: Finish the character tale chains, Mythic Tales, duels, flute song, dyes and Vanity Gear.

roadmap.title: Mainland exploration and liberation
roadmap.description: Liberate Tsushima, then clear every shrine, spring, haiku, fox den, bamboo strike, record and artifact. Finish with Living Legend.

roadmap.title: Iki Island
roadmap.description: Complete the Iki story, tales, collectibles, and archery and tournament challenges. Do this after the main story.

roadmap.title: Legends mode
roadmap.description: Play the online Legends modes (PSN account needed): stories, Survival, Rivals, then rank grinding and raids.

roadmap.title: New Game+
roadmap.description: Start New Game+ last: buy something from Baku and finish Jin's Journey again.

achievements.description: Obtain all base game achievements.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Unlock every base-game achievement (Iki Island, Legends mode, and New Game+ achievements are not required).

steps.text: Unlock every other base-game achievement, including Cooper Clan Cosplayer and A Moment in Time.
If this still stays locked, open @mechanic{Photo Mode} and change a setting using the keyboard or a gamepad, not the mouse.

achievements.description: Recover the katana of clan Sakai.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Recover the katana of clan Sakai during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until you recover the Sakai clan katana.

achievements.description: Break your code to help a new friend.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Abandon the samurai code to help a new ally during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until Jin breaks his code to help a new friend.

achievements.description: Recruit the Straw Hat ronin.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Recruit the Straw Hat ronin during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until the Straw Hat ronin joins you.

achievements.description: Rescue Taka from Mongol captivity.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Rescue Taka from Mongol captivity during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until Taka is rescued from the Mongols.

achievements.description: Free Lord Shimura from the Khan's clutches.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Rescue Lord Shimura from the Khan during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until Lord Shimura is freed from the Khan.

achievements.description: Rally the peasants of Yarikawa.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Rally the peasants of Yarikawa during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until the peasants of Yarikawa are rallied.

achievements.description: Recover your father's armor.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Recover your father's armor during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until Jin recovers his father's armor.

achievements.description: Eradicate the traitors in the name of a fallen friend.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Hunt down the traitors to avenge a fallen friend during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until the traitors are dealt with.

achievements.description: Embrace your new identity.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Embrace your new identity as the Ghost during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until Jin embraces his new identity as the Ghost.

achievements.description: Reunite with your allies in the frozen north.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Meet your allies again in the snowy north during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until you reunite with your allies in the north.

achievements.description: Confront the Khan.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Confront the Khan during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story until the confrontation with the Khan.

achievements.description: Leave the past behind and accept the burden of your new mantle.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Reach the ending of the main story, where Jin accepts his new role.

steps.text: Finish the main story to the ending.

achievements.description: Complete all of Norio's Tales.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all nine of Norio's Tales.

guide.context: Tales unlock as the main story advances. Open the journal's Tales of Tsushima page to see what is left.

collectibles.name: The Last Warrior Monk
collectibles.method: Start from Norio's white marker on the map.

collectibles.name: Three Actions, Three Illusions
collectibles.method: Follow Norio's marker after the previous tale.

collectibles.name: Ghosts in the Fog
collectibles.method: Follow Norio's marker after the previous tale.

collectibles.name: The Birth of Suffering
collectibles.method: Follow Norio's marker after the previous tale.

collectibles.name: The Blood Sutra
collectibles.method: Follow Norio's marker after the previous tale.

collectibles.name: The Cause of Suffering
collectibles.method: Follow Norio's marker after the previous tale.

collectibles.name: The End of Suffering
collectibles.method: Follow Norio's marker after the previous tale.

collectibles.name: The Guardian of Tsushima
collectibles.method: Becomes available once Act 3 begins.

collectibles.name: This Threefold World
collectibles.method: Follow Norio's marker after the previous tale.

achievements.description: Complete all of Masako's Tales.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all ten of Masako's Tales.

guide.context: A Mother's Peace appears only after you finish The Husband and talk to a peasant at the Golden Temple. It is easy to miss.

collectibles.name: The Tale of Lady Masako
collectibles.method: Plays automatically as part of the main campaign.

collectibles.name: The Headman
collectibles.method: Follow Masako's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Husband
collectibles.method: Follow Masako's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Traitor
collectibles.method: Follow Masako's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Fool
collectibles.method: Follow Masako's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Family Man
collectibles.method: Follow Masako's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Thief
collectibles.method: Follow Masako's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Conspirator
collectibles.method: Follow Masako's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Sister Betrayed
collectibles.method: Follow Masako's white marker.

collectibles.name: A Mother's Peace
collectibles.method: Talk to a peasant at the @loc{Golden Temple} once The Husband is done.

achievements.description: Complete all of Ishikawa's Tales.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all nine of Ishikawa's Tales.

guide.context: Some tales stay locked until the main story reaches the listed act.

collectibles.name: The Tale of Sensei Ishikawa
collectibles.method: Plays automatically as part of the main campaign.

collectibles.name: The Sensei and the Student
collectibles.method: Follow Ishikawa's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Past Never Passes
collectibles.method: Follow Ishikawa's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Way of the Bow
collectibles.method: Follow Ishikawa's white marker.

collectibles.name: Dreams of Conquest
collectibles.method: Follow Ishikawa's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Ghost and the Demon Sensei
collectibles.method: Follow Ishikawa's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Terror of Otsuna
collectibles.method: Follow Ishikawa's white marker.

collectibles.name: Friends in Passing
collectibles.method: Follow Ishikawa's white marker.

collectibles.name: Laid to Rest
collectibles.method: Follow Ishikawa's white marker.

achievements.description: Complete all of Yuna's Tales.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all four of Yuna's Tales.

collectibles.name: The Tale of Yuna
collectibles.method: Follow Yuna's white marker.

collectibles.name: Silent Death
collectibles.method: Follow Yuna's white marker.

collectibles.name: The Black Wolf
collectibles.method: Follow Yuna's white marker.

collectibles.name: Message in Blood
collectibles.method: Follow Yuna's white marker.

achievements.description: Complete all of the Mythic Tales.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all seven Mythic Tales.

guide.context: Mythic Tales are marked with large blue map markers. Later ones need more main-story progress.

collectibles.name: The Heavenly Strike
collectibles.method: Act 1. Follow the blue map marker.

collectibles.name: The Curse of Uchitsune
collectibles.method: Act 1. Follow the blue map marker.

collectibles.name: The Legend of Tadayori
collectibles.method: Act 1. A golden bird leads you to the quest giver.

collectibles.name: The Unbreakable Gosaku
collectibles.method: Act 2. Find the musician and finish the tale.

collectibles.name: The Six Blades of Kojiro
collectibles.method: Act 2. Talk to the musician, then win the six duels; five are found away from the tale.

collectibles.name: The Spirit of Yarikawa's Vengeance
collectibles.method: Act 2. Follow the blue map marker.

collectibles.name: The Undying Flame
collectibles.method: Act 3. Talk to the quest giver and finish the tale.

achievements.description: Complete all Tales of Tsushima.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all Tales of Tsushima: every character tale, Mythic Tale, and minor side tale.

guide.context: There are 61 side tales. The journal does not list the ones you have not found, so a leftover tale means checking your completed list.

steps.text: Finish the Norio, Masako, Ishikawa and Yuna tale chains and all seven Mythic Tales.
Also finish Yuriko's two tales, Kenji's three tales, and every minor tale found by talking to people and exploring.
If it stays locked, look first at these three tales: A Mother's Peace, A Debt Repaid and The Cost of Fear.
As a last step, compare the completed list in the @mechanic{journal} against the full list of 61 tales to find any you missed.

achievements.description: Defeat 20 enemies with a counterattack after a Perfect Parry.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Defeat 20 enemies with a counterattack right after a Perfect Parry.

steps.text: Block just before an enemy's hit lands to trigger a @mechanic{Perfect Parry}, then attack during the slow motion to kill the enemy.
Repeat until 20 enemies have died this way. The counterattack must kill the enemy.
For easier parries, scale the Spring Falls Shrine in @loc{Komoda} to earn the @item{Mizu-No-Kami Charm}, then wear it.

achievements.description: Shoot a Terrified enemy with an arrow while they are fleeing.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Shoot a terrified, fleeing enemy with an arrow.

guide.context: Enemies only become afraid once your reputation has grown through the story. Ghost armor and Sakai Clan armor can add a chance to terrify.

steps.text: Make a group of enemies afraid, for example by winning a @mechanic{Standoff} or killing with @mechanic{Ghost Stance}.
Pull out your bow and shoot an enemy while it runs away.

achievements.description: Defeat the maximum amount of enemies within a single Standoff.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Defeat the maximum of 5 enemies in a single Standoff.

guide.context: The upgraded Sakai Clan Armor adds 2 kills and the technique adds the rest, for 5 in total.

steps.text: Unlock the @mechanic{Improved Standoff Streak} technique in Techniques, Ghost, Evolving Tactics (2 skill points).
Get the @item{Sakai Clan Armor} in the Act 2 story quest 'Ghosts From the Past' and upgrade it to Level VI.
Start a @mechanic{Standoff} against a large group and cut down all 5 enemies.

achievements.description: Successfully Stagger enemies 50 times.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Successfully stagger enemies 50 times.

steps.text: Hit enemies with heavy attacks until their guard breaks.
Use the matching stance: @mechanic{Stone} for swordsmen, @mechanic{Water} for shieldmen, @mechanic{Wind} for spearmen, @mechanic{Moon} for brutes.

achievements.description: Successfully complete every duel.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Successfully win every duel in the game.

guide.context: There are 25 duels in total: 6 in the story, 15 in tales, and 4 in Mongol territories.

steps.text: Complete the main story and Tales of Tsushima; most duels happen inside quests.
In the Mythic Tale 'The Six Blades of Kojiro', find and win the duels that are not part of the tale.
Win the duels found while liberating Mongol territories.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with fall damage by knocking them off a ledge.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with fall damage.

guide.context: Do this while outposts still have enemies on towers and ledges.

steps.text: Switch to @mechanic{Wind} stance.
Find an enemy on a high place, such as an archer on a tower, and hit it with a charged heavy attack (Typhoon Kick) to knock it off.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies with Ghost Stance strikes.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Get 20 kills using Ghost Stance attacks.

steps.text: Progress the story until you unlock @mechanic{Ghost Stance} in 'The Ghost of Yarikawa'.
Kill 7 enemies without taking damage to enter Ghost Stance, then strike. Each activation lets you kill up to 3 enemies.
Repeat until 20 enemies have died to Ghost Stance strikes.

achievements.description: Build your Legend to earn the title Ghost of Tsushima.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Reach the top Legend rank, which grants the Ghost of Tsushima title.

guide.context: Legend rises by finishing quests, Mythic Tales and liberations, and by saving civilians in the world.

steps.text: Play the story, tales and liberations to raise your Legend until the final rank (the 11th) is reached.

achievements.description: Learn the Stone, Water, Wind, and Moon combat stances.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Unlock all four combat stances: Stone, Water, Wind and Moon.

guide.context: Stone is known from the start. Observing a leader and then killing it gives 2 points toward the next stance.

steps.text: Sneak up on a Mongol leader in a camp or stronghold and use the observe prompt before attacking.
Then kill the leader for a second stance point.

achievements.description: Acquire all the throwable Ghost Weapon techniques.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Acquire every throwable Ghost Weapon technique.

steps.text: Raise your Legend and spend each new point on a Ghost Weapon until all five in the Ghost Weapons menu are unlocked.
Spend 1 technique point on @item{Firecracker}, found under the @item{Wind Chimes} technique.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade your sword.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade your sword (katana) to its maximum level.

guide.context: Maxing the katana takes 13 gold, 155 steel, 320 iron and 3,250 supplies in total; skip the short blade. Gold is scarce, so check trappers and clear big Mongol territories.

steps.text: Collect @item{supplies}, @item{iron}, @item{steel} and @item{gold}. Mongol camps, villages and strongholds give iron and steel.
Upgrade the @item{katana} at a blacksmith until it reaches Level VII.

achievements.description: Equip a charm in all 6 slots.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Equip a charm in all 6 charm slots.

steps.text: Pray at @loc{Inari Shrines} (fox dens) until you have unlocked all 6 charm slots.
Equip a different charm in each of the 6 slots. Charms come from Shinto Shrines and side tales.

achievements.description: Collect 10 gifts.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Collect 10 gifts from altars.

guide.context: Altars are at the Golden Temple, Akashima Village, Yarikawa Village, Omi Lake, and Jogaku Temple.

steps.text: Finish tales and rescue civilians; gifts appear at the nearest altar.
Visit an altar, such as the @loc{Golden Temple}, to pick up the gifts until you have 10.

achievements.description: Acquire 30 pieces of Vanity Gear.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Acquire 30 pieces of Vanity Gear.

steps.text: Complete Haiku spots; each gives a headband.
Visit @loc{Pillars of Honor} to collect sword kits. Together with the headbands you will reach 30 quickly.

achievements.description: Rekindle all the lighthouses of Tsushima.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Rekindle all 8 mainland lighthouses.

guide.context: The in-game tracker counts 10 lighthouses, but only 8 are on the mainland. The achievement is known to be buggy.

steps.text: Light the lighthouses along the coast. Two are lit during story quests: the Tsutsu lighthouse and the Akashima lighthouse.
If it does not unlock after all 8, fast travel from one lighthouse to the next and light them again.

achievements.description: Discover Umugi Cove.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Discover Umugi Cove during the main story.

steps.text: Advance the main story into Toyotama until you reach @loc{Umugi Cove}.

achievements.description: Find and honor all of the Shinto Shrines on Tsushima.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Find and honor all 16 Shinto Shrines on Tsushima.

guide.context: Izuhara holds 7, Toyotama 6 and Kamiagata 3.

steps.text: Follow torii gates or use guiding wind to each @loc{Shinto Shrine} on the map.
Climb the shrine and honor it at the top.

achievements.description: Bow to 10 hidden altars across Tsushima.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Bow at 10 hidden altars across Tsushima.

guide.context: There are 35 hidden altars but only 10 are needed. A map website helps.

steps.text: Look for a small sign with a bowing figure; these altars are not on the map.
Stand next to the sign and use the bow gesture. A special effect plays when it works.

achievements.description: Discover a pillar of honor and collect its sword kit.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Find any Pillar of Honor and take the sword kit it holds.

steps.text: Find any @loc{Pillar of Honor} on the map and collect its sword kit.

achievements.description: Purchase an item from the black and white dye merchants.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Buy an item from both the black and white dye merchants.

guide.context: The cheapest item at each merchant costs 5 flowers, so bring at least 10 flowers.

steps.text: Buy one item from the White Dye Merchant at the base of the watchtower near @loc{Wanderer's Pass} in Izuhara.
Buy one item from the Black Dye Merchant in a small cave in @loc{Kawamata Village}, Toyotama.

achievements.description: Dress up as a legendary thief.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Equip Gosaku's Armor dyed Blue Ocean's Guardian, plus the Crooked Kama headband and the Sly Tanuki sword kit.

steps.text: Finish the Mythic Tale 'The Unbreakable Gosaku' to get @item{Gosaku's Armor}.
Buy the @item{Blue Ocean's Guardian} dye for 10 flowers from a Toyotama merchant and apply it to the armor.
Take the @item{Crooked Kama} headband from the top of the pagoda at @loc{Jogaku Temple}.
Collect the @item{Sly Tanuki} sword kit at the Pillar of Honor on the Kamiagata shore, just east of @loc{Iwai Village}. Avoid the lookalike Moon Bear's Paw and Heavenly Falcon kits.
Equip all four items together.

achievements.description: Play the Lament of the Storm at a friend's grave.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Play the song Lament of the Storm at Taka's grave.

steps.text: Finish the Act 2 story tale 'A Reckoning in Blood'.
Find 5 @item{Singing Crickets} in small cages in cemeteries (listen for chirping) to learn the flute song.
Equip @item{Lament of the Storm} in Gear, then Accessories.
Fast travel to the east coast of @loc{Yarikawa}, walk up to Taka's grave mound, and play the song.

achievements.description: Personalize a scene in Photo Mode.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Personalize a scene in Photo Mode.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Photo Mode} (P on keyboard) and change some settings in the bottom left corner, using the keyboard or a gamepad rather than the mouse.

achievements.description: Collect 20 Records.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Collect 20 Records.

guide.context: There are 40 records, but only 20 are needed.

steps.text: Put on the @item{Traveler's Attire}, open the map and set a Guiding Wind target on records.
Collect records until you have 20.

achievements.description: Collect 20 Mongol artifacts.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Collect 20 Mongol artifacts.

guide.context: There are 50 artifacts, but only 20 are needed.

steps.text: Put on the @item{Traveler's Attire}, open the map and set a Guiding Wind target on Mongol artifacts.
Collect artifacts until you have 20.

achievements.description: Complete all Hot Springs, Haiku, Inari Shrines, and Bamboo Strikes.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish every mainland Hot Spring, Haiku, Inari Shrine and Bamboo Strike.

guide.context: That is 102 spots in total. After liberating Tsushima, uncompleted spots show as '?' on the map.

steps.text: Finish the story and liberate Tsushima first so missing spots show on the map as '?'.
Visit every hot spring (18), haiku spot (19), Inari shrine (49), and bamboo strike (16).
If the count is complete but the achievement does not unlock, visit the tutorial hot spring and haiku at @loc{Hiyoshi Springs}; they have no map marker.

achievements.description: Liberate 12 occupied areas in Izuhara.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Liberate 12 occupied areas in Izuhara.

guide.context: Izuhara has 24 Mongol-occupied areas.

steps.text: Clear enemies from 12 of the 24 occupied areas in @loc{Izuhara}.

achievements.description: Liberate all occupied areas in Izuhara.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Liberate all 24 occupied areas in Izuhara.

guide.context: Izuhara has 24 Mongol-occupied areas. After the story, undiscovered ones show on the map.

steps.text: Clear enemies from every occupied area in @loc{Izuhara}.

achievements.description: Liberate 8 occupied areas in Toyotama.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Liberate 8 occupied areas in Toyotama.

guide.context: Toyotama has 17 Mongol-occupied areas.

steps.text: Clear enemies from 8 of the 17 occupied areas in @loc{Toyotama}.

achievements.description: Liberate all occupied areas in Toyotama.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Liberate all 17 occupied areas in Toyotama.

guide.context: Toyotama has 17 Mongol-occupied areas. After the story, undiscovered ones show on the map.

steps.text: Clear enemies from every occupied area in @loc{Toyotama}.

achievements.description: Liberate 7 occupied areas in Kamiagata.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Liberate 7 occupied areas in Kamiagata.

guide.context: Kamiagata has 15 Mongol-occupied areas.

steps.text: Clear enemies from 7 of the 15 occupied areas in @loc{Kamiagata}.

achievements.description: Liberate all occupied areas in Kamiagata.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Liberate all 15 occupied areas in Kamiagata.

guide.context: Kamiagata has 15 Mongol-occupied areas. After the story, undiscovered ones show on the map.

steps.text: Clear enemies from every occupied area in @loc{Kamiagata}.

achievements.description: Liberate the entirety of Tsushima Island.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Free every one of the 56 occupied areas across Tsushima.

guide.context: This unlocks after the three regional liberation achievements are done.

steps.text: Finish liberating every occupied area in Izuhara, Toyotama and Kamiagata.

achievements.description: Complete all 3 Raid chapters.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all 3 raid chapters in Legends mode.

guide.context: Raids give no quest markers. If a player leaves, the raid may become impossible to finish.

steps.text: Find a group on the official Ghost of Tsushima Discord, or invite friends. Joining a raid in progress through matchmaking is not possible.
Equip your highest-Ki gear before starting.
Finish Raid chapter 1 (about 30-40 minutes). Deaths are unlimited and you respawn at the last checkpoint.
Finish Raid chapter 2 (about 1-1.5 hours). Have at least one player with a mic to call out puzzle solutions.
Finish Raid chapter 3 (about 5 minutes).

achievements.description: Reach rank 20 with all roles.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Reach rank 20 with all four Legends roles.

guide.context: Class XP comes from story missions, Survival and Rivals. Replaying the short first story mission on the highest difficulty is the fastest way to level.

steps.text: Reach rank 20 with your first class (see Self-Actualized).
Switch to a new class and repeat until all four classes (Samurai, Hunter, Ronin, Assassin) are at rank 20.

achievements.description: Complete the final wave in a gold Survival.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Survive through the last wave of a gold-difficulty Survival match.

steps.text: Raise your Ki level to at least 75 to unlock gold Survival. Ki 90 or more makes it much easier.
Start a gold Survival (quickplay or with a group) and survive all 15 waves while defending the 3 points.

achievements.description: Complete a Legends Mode story.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete a Legends Mode story mission.

steps.text: Play and finish any @mechanic{Legends} story mission. Start with the first one and go in order.

achievements.description: Complete all Legends Mode stories on a single difficulty.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish the nine Legends story missions, all on the same difficulty.

guide.context: Gear drops from missions, so equip your highest-Ki gear each time.

steps.text: Choose one difficulty, such as bronze, and play all 9 story missions in order on it.

achievements.description: Reach rank 20 in any role.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Reach rank 20 in any one Legends role.

steps.text: Play Legends missions with one class (best on the highest difficulty you unlocked) until it is rank 20.

achievements.description: Purchase something from Baku the Voiceless in New Game+.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 6; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Make a purchase from Baku the Voiceless during New Game+.

guide.context: This may already be unlocked if you linked a PSN account on your first run.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{New Game+} after finishing everything else, then talk to Baku the Voiceless at the start.
Spend @item{Ghost Flowers} on any item.

achievements.description: Complete Jin's Journey in New Game+.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 6; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete Jin's Journey in New Game+.

guide.context: Do this last. Most collectibles do not carry over to New Game+, so finish them in the first run.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{New Game+} and play only the main story to the end.

achievements.description: Survive the Eagle's medicine and bid farewell to a new friend.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish the Iki Island main story.

steps.text: Complete the nine Iki Island story quests in order, up to the epilogue.

achievements.description: Complete all Tales of Iki.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all Tales of Iki: 9 main, 7 side, and 2 Mythic Tales.

guide.context: Unwritten tales are not needed for this achievement.

steps.text: Finish the 9 Iki main story quests.
Finish the 5 side tales marked on the map, plus A Mother's Law (talk to @npc{Fune} after the story) and A Helping Hand (not on the map).
For A Helping Hand, deliver 3 @item{Yew Wood} north of @loc{Tatsu's Ladder}, 6 @item{Predator Hides} northeast of @loc{Lake Nagata}, and 10 @item{Iron} at the @loc{Zasho Bay} shipwreck.
Also finish the 2 Iki Mythic Tales.

achievements.description: Build your Legend on Iki Island to earn the title Legacy Redeemer.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Max out Iki Island's own Legend track to receive the title Legacy Redeemer.

steps.text: Progress the Iki story, Mythic Tales, and liberations until the Iki Legend reaches its final rank.

achievements.description: Liberate Iki Island by defeating the Eagle and driving the invaders from Mongol territory.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Eagle and liberate Iki Island by clearing all 4 occupied areas.

steps.text: Finish the Iki story to defeat the Eagle.
Liberate all 4 Mongol territories on Iki Island.

achievements.description: Complete all Mythic Tales on Iki Island.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete both Mythic Tales on Iki Island.

guide.context: Both tales need a fair bit of Iki story progress, so do them after the main story.

steps.text: Finish 'The Legend of Black Hand Riku'.
Finish 'The Legacy of Kazumasa Sakai'. It starts near @loc{Zasho Bay}; unequip the Sakai Clan Armor before starting.

achievements.description: Complete all Memories of Your Father.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all five Memories of Your Father on Iki Island.

steps.text: Follow the map markers for the five Memories of Your Father and finish each short mission.

achievements.description: Discover and complete all unwritten tales on Iki Island.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Discover and finish all five unwritten tales on Iki Island.

guide.context: Unwritten tales do not appear on the map or in the journal.

collectibles.name: The body at the shipwreck
collectibles.method: Go up to the dead man and give him a burial through the prompt.

collectibles.name: Hachibee's bees
collectibles.method: Help Hachibee protect his bees from Mongol attacks.

collectibles.name: The burned house
collectibles.method: Use the Sakai banner, then defeat the Mongols by the purple-leafed trees. Return to the stump for the supplies and scroll.

collectibles.name: Peasants in the ponds
collectibles.method: Quickly kill all enemies to save the peasants being drowned.

collectibles.name: Raider Memorial archery challenge
collectibles.method: Equip the @item{Tadayori Armor}, speak to the raider, and finish the archery challenge.

achievements.description: Embody the spirit of the monkey on Saruiwa.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Perform the matching action at each of the three monkey statues in the Saruiwa sanctuary, then play the flute at the summit.

guide.context: A short cutscene plays after each correct action.

steps.text: Go to the Monkey Sanctuary on @loc{Saruiwa}, the peninsula south of Sarubashi.
At the monkey statue covering its ears, play the @item{flute}.
At the monkey statue covering its eyes, throw a @item{smoke bomb}.
At the monkey statue covering its mouth, use the bow gesture.
At the summit, stand on the round stone tile before the big rock monkey and play the flute.

achievements.description: Achieve bronze or higher on all Archery Challenges.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Earn bronze or better on all 8 archery challenges on Iki Island.

guide.context: Gear or charms that boost archery or concentration help.

steps.text: Finish the 7 archery challenges marked on the map with at least bronze (all lanterns within 22 seconds).
The 8th is at the Raider Memorial, south of @loc{Buddha's Footprints}: equip the @item{Tadayori Armor}, talk to the raider, and shoot all lanterns.

achievements.description: Complete all Animal Sanctuaries.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete all 9 Animal Sanctuaries on Iki Island.

steps.text: Visit all 9 animal sanctuaries on the map (3 cat, 3 monkey, 3 deer) and finish the music mini-game at each.

achievements.description: Complete all bokken duels at the Hidden Cove Tournament.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Defeat all four bokken opponents in the Hidden Cove tournament.

guide.context: Unlocked after the quest 'Jin From Yarikawa'. Win each match by landing 5 hits.

collectibles.name: Owan 'Exiled Monk'
collectibles.method: Use Moon Stance with heavy attacks and dodge; do not parry.

collectibles.name: Kai 'Brutal Raider'
collectibles.method: Any stance works; sidestep right so you end up at his back.

collectibles.name: Take 'Murderous Merchant'
collectibles.method: Use any stance and perfect parry.

collectibles.name: Sao 'Crimson Fisherman'
collectibles.method: Use Water Stance with charged heavy attacks.

achievements.description: Complete all Haiku, Onsen, Shinto Shrines, and Bamboo Strikes on Iki Island.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish every Haiku, Hot Spring, Shinto Shrine and Bamboo Strike on Iki.

guide.context: That is 10 spots in total.

steps.text: Do the 3 haiku, 2 hot springs, single shinto shrine and 4 bamboo strikes found on Iki.

achievements.description: Purchase an item from the Crimson Dye Merchant and obtain a dye for your Sakai Horse Armor.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Make a purchase from the Crimson Dye Merchant, and acquire a dye for the Sakai Horse Armor.

steps.text: Finish all bokken duels (A Few Splinters), then buy any item from the dye merchant west of @loc{Tatsu's Ladder}.
Finish the Mythic Tale 'The Legacy of Kazumasa Sakai' to get the Sakai Horse Armor.
Collect six Sakai Clan Banners and hand them over to the horse armor dye merchant, southwest of @loc{Zasho Bay}, in exchange for a dye.

achievements.description: Bind a piece of gear to a class.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Permanently bind one gear item to a class.

steps.text: Obtain a Ki 110 gear item, either as a platinum Survival drop or by reforging a level 105 item.
Select the gear, open modifications, and choose the bottom option, @mechanic{Active Mastery Challenge}. This permanently binds it to that class.

achievements.description: Win a Legends Rivals match.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Win a Legends Rivals match.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Rivals} match and turn matchmaking off once it starts.
Kill enemies on your side, collect @item{Magatamas}, and buy shades. Then defend the point that appears through 3 waves to win.

achievements.description: Purify a Cursed piece of gear.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Purify a Cursed piece of gear.

steps.text: Bind a piece of gear first (see Honor Bound); cursed gear starts dropping after that.
Play gold or higher missions until a red cursed item drops, then equip it and read its challenge.
Complete the challenge in a gold mission, then choose purify in the menu.

achievements.description: Summon five Shades in a single Rivals match.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Call in five Shades during one Rivals match.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Rivals} match and turn matchmaking off.
Kill enemies on your side, collect @item{Magatamas}, and buy shades near the spawn area until you have summoned five.
If the match ends first, choose rematch and keep buying shades.
